name: File Processor
description: Convert files to Markdown with local OCR (PDF, images, DOCX), transcribe audio, convert SVG to PNG

changelog.notes: Local OCR via @teros/ocr (tesseract.js WASM) — scanned PDFs and images are now OCR'd locally without API keys. New ocr-extract tool for structured OCR output with confidence scores. Image support: png, jpg, tiff, webp, gif, bmp.
Initial release — convert documents to Markdown, transcribe audio to text, and turn SVGs into PNG images
